description: Verified exam notes for 22 November 2026 covering disaster management, renewable energy, labour platforms, social defence, cooperatives, science, skills and Tamil-linked cultural initiatives.

stories.title: Government details Small Hydro Power Development Scheme for 2026–31
stories.summary: The Union Government has approved the Small Hydro Power Development Scheme for FY 2026–27 to FY 2030–31 with an outlay of ₹2,584.60 crore. The scheme aims to add about 1,500 MW, with targeted financial support for difficult geographies, project preparation and technical capacity building. This is an approved scheme; the projected capacity, investment and employment figures are targets, not completed outcomes.
key_facts: In India, small hydropower covers projects with installed capacity up to 25 MW and is administered by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
India's identified small-hydro potential is 21,134 MW across 7,133 sites, with roughly one-quarter harnessed according to the government backgrounder.
The scheme outlay is ₹2,584.60 crore and the targeted additional capacity is approximately 1,500 MW.
For North-Eastern states and international-border districts, assistance is ₹3.6 crore per MW or 30% of project cost, whichever is lower, capped at ₹30 crore per project.
A separate ₹30 crore allocation supports preparation of detailed project reports for at least 200 projects.
stories.exam_link: Revise renewable-energy classification, run-of-river generation, Himalayan and North-Eastern hydropower potential, and the division of responsibility between MNRE and the Ministry of Power.
stories.source_title: PIB: Harnessing Small Hydro Power, 22 November 2026

stories.title: NCS ONE Portal and e-Shram Livelihood Profile Module launched
stories.summary: At the Labour and Employment Ministers' Chintan Shivir in Gandhinagar, the Union Labour Minister formally launched the National Career Service Open Network for Employment portal, the e-Shram Livelihood Profile Module and eight Career Lounges. NCS ONE is designed to connect job-seeker applications, employer applications, state employment portals, private platforms and campuses through an open network.
key_facts: NCS ONE includes a Voice Bot, Chat Bot and Occupational Shortage Index.
The Occupational Shortage Index is intended to identify labour-market demand and supply gaps.
The e-Shram Livelihood Profile records livelihood information alongside five social-security protections called Panch Suraksha.
Panch Suraksha covers food security, health protection, life insurance, accident and disability protection, and pension security.
Eight Career Lounges were launched at Jaipur, Ludhiana, Bhubaneswar, Kanpur, Bengaluru, Varanasi, Hyderabad and Guwahati; the broader plan is for 200 centres.
stories.exam_link: Connect the development with labour-market information systems, the e-Shram database for unorganised workers, cooperative federalism and social-security delivery.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment: Chintan Shivir initiatives, 22 November 2026

stories.title: NDRF's 12th Battalion campus inaugurated near Itanagar
stories.summary: The Union Home Minister inaugurated the campus of the National Disaster Response Force's 12th Battalion near Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh. The earthquake-resistant facility is intended to support disaster response across Arunachal Pradesh, the wider Northeast and adjoining regions, while also training State Disaster Response Forces from all eight northeastern states.
key_facts: All buildings at the campus were constructed to earthquake-resistant standards.
The campus includes an Olympic-size swimming pool and a diving tank for personnel training.
NDRF is deployed at more than 70 locations across India, according to the Home Ministry release.
NDRF has conducted more than 11,000 operations and saved over 1.61 lakh lives.
The year 2026 has been declared the Year of Capacity Building for NDRF.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Disaster Management Act, 2005; roles of NDMA, NDRF and SDRFs; disaster-risk reduction; early-warning systems; and India's multi-hazard vulnerability.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Home Affairs: NDRF 12th Battalion campus inaugurated, 22 November 2026

stories.title: NISD exchanges 23 MoUs to expand social-defence partnerships
stories.summary: The National Institute of Social Defence exchanged memoranda of understanding with 23 universities and institutions to expand training, research, curriculum development, outreach and evidence-based interventions. The partnerships cover substance-use prevention, senior-citizen welfare, transgender welfare and prevention of beggary.
key_facts: NISD functions under the Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Fifteen partner institutions participated in person and eight joined virtually.
The 23 new agreements raised NISD's institutional partnerships to 30, including seven earlier MoUs.
The MoU scope includes prevention education, research, training, capacity building, curriculum development, outreach and advocacy.
Partner institutions include universities, law universities, rural-development institutes and public training institutions.
stories.exam_link: Study the constitutional welfare orientation under the Directive Principles, Union social-justice institutions, drug-demand reduction and policy protections for vulnerable groups.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment: NISD exchanges 23 MoUs, 22 November 2026

stories.title: Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision 2047 unveiled with development projects
stories.summary: At a Cooperative Festival in Itanagar, the Union Cooperation Minister unveiled the Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision 2047 and launched development projects valued at ₹5,610.95 crore. The programme also included mobile medical vans and the SARAS Mela. Statements about a future milk-processing plant and an additional daily Itanagar–Delhi flight remain proposals or expectations, not completed facilities.
key_facts: The programme was organised under the Sahkar Se Samriddhi vision.
The announced development-project value was ₹5,610.95 crore.
The vision emphasises cooperative institutions, rural livelihoods and market access for women's self-help groups.
The Minister called for fisheries and dairy cooperatives and stated that NDDB and Amul would procure milk under the proposed dairy expansion.
SARAS fairs provide marketing platforms for rural products and self-help groups.
stories.exam_link: Revise the constitutional status of cooperatives, the Ministry of Cooperation, dairy and fisheries cooperatives, SHGs, and the economic geography of Arunachal Pradesh.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Cooperation: Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision and projects, 22 November 2026

stories.title: First SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum concludes in New Delhi
stories.summary: The first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum concluded in New Delhi after three days of sessions on shared heritage, languages, manuscripts and monastic traditions. The Ministry of Culture and Ministry of External Affairs jointly organised the forum, with IGNCA as knowledge partner. It brought together 116 delegates from 22 countries.
key_facts: The forum was inaugurated on 20 November 2026 at Purana Qila, New Delhi, and concluded on 22 November.
The gathering included 116 delegates from 22 countries, four ministers and the SCO Secretary-General.
Final-day themes covered language, literature, scripts, manuscript traditions and monastic trails.
Proposed cooperation areas included digitisation, collaborative research, exhibitions, academic exchanges and cultural tourism.
The Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts served as the knowledge partner.
stories.exam_link: Revise the SCO's Eurasian focus, India's cultural diplomacy, Central Asian linkages, manuscript conservation and the role of IGNCA under the Ministry of Culture.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Culture: First SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum concludes, 22 November 2026

stories.title: Government highlights preventive and precision-health research priorities
stories.summary: At a health summit in New Delhi, the Union Science and Technology Minister outlined a shift towards prevention, early detection, molecular research and precision medicine. The address cited genome sequencing of 10,000 Indians across 84 populations as a research resource for studying genetic diversity and disease susceptibility. This was a policy and research-priority statement, not the launch of a new treatment programme.
key_facts: The cited genomics work covers 10,000 individuals from 84 Indian populations.
Precision medicine adapts prevention or treatment using genetic profile, lifestyle, environment and other individual factors.
The address linked molecular and genetic research with earlier disease detection and targeted interventions.
Diabetes, obesity, hypertension and cardiovascular disease were identified as growing risks among younger people.
The Minister called for collaboration among public institutions, researchers, health professionals and private partners.
stories.exam_link: Revise genomics, population diversity, precision medicine, non-communicable diseases, preventive healthcare and ethical handling of genetic information.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Science and Technology: Preventive healthcare research priorities, 22 November 2026

stories.title: Chennai to host Silk Mark Expo alongside international sericulture congress
stories.summary: The Silk Mark Organisation of India announced that Silk Mark Expo 2026 will be held in Chennai from 23 to 27 November alongside the 27th Congress of the International Sericultural Commission. The expo is scheduled, not yet completed. It is intended to promote genuine Indian silk, consumer awareness, weavers and trade links.
key_facts: The Silk Mark Organisation of India is an initiative of the Central Silk Board under the Ministry of Textiles.
The expo is scheduled at Hyatt Regency, Chennai, from 23 to 27 November 2026.
India's four major silk varieties are Mulberry, Tasar, Eri and Muga.
The release records about 7,500 Silk Mark authorised users across India, including 1,700 in Tamil Nadu.
Delegates from more than 23 member countries are expected through the linked sericulture congress.
stories.exam_link: Revise sericulture, the Central Silk Board, Silk Mark certification, the geography of Indian silk varieties and Tamil Nadu's textile economy.
stories.source_title: PIB Chennai: Chennai Hosts Silk Mark Expo 2026, 22 November 2026

stories.title: Pre-events held for fifth Kashi Tamil Sangamam
stories.summary: Banaras Hindu University hosted a photography competition at Kamakoteeshwar Temple and a bhajan evening as preparatory activities for Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0. The fifth edition of the Sangamam is scheduled for 28 November to 12 December 2026; the main programme had not begun on the edition date.
key_facts: The photography activity focused on Kamakoteeshwar Temple near Harishchandra Ghat in Varanasi.
The temple is associated with the Kanchi Kamakoti Peetham.
The fifth Kashi Tamil Sangamam is scheduled from 28 November to 12 December 2026.
The initiative highlights cultural and spiritual links between Kashi and Tamil Nadu.
The pre-events introduced students to temple architecture, shared heritage and the Sangamam's objectives.
stories.exam_link: Connect Kashi Tamil Sangamam with cultural integration, Varanasi's historical geography, Tamil links with Kashi, temple traditions and Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Education: Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 pre-events, 22 November 2026

stories.title: Fifth Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh held in Lucknow
stories.summary: The Prime Minister participated in the fifth Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow. The event presented skill education and vocational capability as central to employment, productivity and India's goal of becoming a global skills hub. The official release records the event and policy emphasis; it does not announce a new statutory qualification or recruitment guarantee.
key_facts: The fifth Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh was held in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
Kaushal Deekshant is a skills convocation recognising trainees from the vocational training ecosystem.
The address used the phrase Shrameva Jayate to emphasise dignity and recognition of skilled work.
Skill development was linked with technology use, service delivery, entrepreneurship and national productive capacity.
stories.exam_link: Revise India's vocational-education framework, Industrial Training Institutes, apprenticeships, the National Skill Development Mission and the role of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship: Fifth Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh, 22 November 2026

mcqs.explanation: Small hydropower in India covers projects with installed capacity up to 25 MW and falls under MNRE.
